newsitem.title: USA: Putnam Vista Fund manager recruited by Neuberger.
newsitem.headline: Putnam Vista Fund manager recruited by Neuberger.

text.p: Putnam Investments on Friday said Jennifer Silver, portfolio manager of the Putnam Vista Fund, was leaving the firm to join Neuberger & Berman, LLC.

At Putnam, Silver led a money-management team responsible for about $5.5 billion, including the $3.7 billion Vista Fund and mid-capitalization growth stocks for institutional clients, Neuberger said in a separate statement.

At Neuberger, Silver will manage the $600 million Manhattan Fund and lead the firm's new growth-oriented investment group, which will also manage $800 million in variable annuity linked-portfolios, the company said.
Silver, who will join Neuberger on July 1, will also open an office in Boston for the company.
Mark Goldstein, who has managed the Manhattan Fund since 1992, will focus on managing separate accounts, Neuberger said.
Putnam said its mid-cap stock growth portfolio team, which includes the Putnam Vista Fund, would continue to be managed in the same style.
"Putnam has a strong mid-cap growth team, both in terms of people and process, and we are confident of our ongoing success in this investment area," said Putnam senior managing director Tim Ferguson.
